descriptionChirho: Ethically evil or wicked, describing persons, conduct, or character as morally corrupt (Arabic shirrīr/sharīr, Korean akhan, Swahili mwovu/waovu).
Abstract evil as harm, misfortune, disaster, or calamity; the substantive concept of evil or trouble befalling someone (Arabic sharr, Korean ak, Swahili uovu).
Bad in quality, worthless, or inferior; describing things, land, fruit, or conditions that are deficient rather than morally evil (Arabic radī'/sayyi', Korean nappŭn, Swahili mbaya).
Ugly or foul in appearance, as in Pharaoh's ill-favored cows in Genesis 41 (Arabic qabīḥ, Korean nappŭn, Swahili wabaya).
Sad, downcast, or displeased in countenance or spirit, as in Nehemiah 2:2 (Arabic ḥazīn/sayyi', Korean nappŭn, Swahili huzuni).
Severe, fierce, or dangerous, describing wild beasts, terrible diseases, or harsh conditions (Arabic shadīd/sharīr, Korean simhan/sanaun, Swahili mkali).
